introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: AI Pajak ('we', 'us', or 'our') is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your personal information when you use our tax filing services.

dataCollection.title: Information We Collect
dataCollection.intro: We collect the following information to provide our services:

items.identity: Identity information: Name, NIK, NPWP, date of birth
items.contact: Contact information: Email address, phone number, address
items.tax: Tax information: Income data, deductions, tax documents
items.financial: Financial information: Bank account details, payment history
items.usage: Usage data: Access logs, IP address, device information

items.taxServices: Prepare and submit your tax returns to DJP
items.communication: Communicate with you about our services
items.improvement: Improve our services and user experience
items.legal: Comply with legal obligations and tax regulations

dataProtection.title: Data Security
dataProtection.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. This includes data encryption, strict access controls, and regular security audits.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We retain your tax information for a minimum of 5 (five) years in accordance with Indonesian tax regulations. Data will be deleted or anonymized after the retention period ends, unless required for legal purposes.

items.access: Access the personal information we hold about you
items.deletion: Request deletion of your data (subject to legal limitations)
items.objection: Object to processing for certain purposes

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Sharing
thirdParty.content: We may share your information with: Direktorat Jenderal Pajak (DJP) for tax reporting, payment service providers to process transactions, and authorized business partners (Jakarta Tax Consulting) for tax consulting services. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your rights, please contact us:

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using AI Pajak services, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our services.

services.title: Service Description
services.content: AI Pajak provides a digital tax filing platform that helps you prepare, calculate, and report taxes to DJP through our partnership with Jakarta Tax Consulting (JTC).

items.lawful: Use the services only for lawful purposes
items.compliance: Comply with all applicable tax laws and regulations

poa.title: Power of Attorney
poa.content: To use tax filing services, you must sign a Power of Attorney authorizing JTC to act on your behalf in tax matters.

fees.title: Fees and Payment
fees.content: Service fees will be displayed before you subscribe. Payments are processed through our secure payment gateway. Refunds are subject to our cancellation policy.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.content: AI Pajak is not responsible for errors arising from inaccurate information you provide. We do not guarantee specific tax filing results or refunds.

termination.title: Termination
termination.content: We may suspend or terminate your access to services if you violate these Terms and Conditions or at your own request.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.content: We may update these Terms and Conditions from time to time. Material changes will be notified via email or in-app notification.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: For questions about these Terms and Conditions, please contact:
